    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w15_how global_var:oe_ilk_w15_how = 1 } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w15_how global_var:oe_ilk_w15_how = 2 } add = 200 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w16_how global_var:oe_ilk_w16_how = 1 } add = 1000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w16_how global_var:oe_ilk_w16_how = 2 } add = 2000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w13_burhan global_var:oe_ilk_w13_burhan = 1 } add = 10000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w13_burhan global_var:oe_ilk_w13_burhan = 2 } add = 20000 }
}
# oe_ilk_rd_w9: how many subjects the Chobanids had when w9 annexed them (what became of them is to be looked at in
# game), + 100 when the Jalayirid state carries the title marker of sultan.
oe_ilk_rd_w9 = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w9_subs } value = global_var:oe_ilk_w9_subs }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_jal_alive = yes global_var:oe_ilk_jal = { has_variable = oe_ilk_jal_sultan } } add = 100 }
}
# The BYZ variables: .2 and .3 (1 shown, 2 given up), the choice of .2 (1 pact, 2 letter, 3 told the sultan) and of .3
# (1 Straits closed, 2 ferried, 3 only our prince's men), the months since Ankara (-1: not seen).
oe_ilk_rd_done2 = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_done_2 } value = var:oe_ilk_done_2 } }
oe_ilk_rd_done3 = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_done_3 } value = var:oe_ilk_done_3 } }
oe_ilk_rd_timur = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_timur } value = var:oe_ilk_timur } }
oe_ilk_rd_ferry = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_ferry } value = var:oe_ilk_ferry } }
oe_ilk_rd_ank = { value = -1 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ilk_ank_m } value = var:oe_ilk_ank_m } }
# The exiles have fled to the Ottomans (w14 c).
oe_ilk_rd_ref = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_refugees } value = global_var:oe_ilk_refugees } }

# ================================================================ phase 3
# BYZ scope. Monthly chance of a world step of phase 3: 100 / the months left in its window (the last month is sure).
oe_ilk_left_w17 = { value = 61 subtract = var:oe_ilk_m min = 1 }
oe_ilk_ch_w17 = { value = 100 divide = oe_ilk_left_w17 }
oe_ilk_left_w18 = { value = 211 subtract = var:oe_ilk_m min = 1 }
oe_ilk_ch_w18 = { value = 100 divide = oe_ilk_left_w18 }
oe_ilk_left_w19 = { value = 253 subtract = var:oe_ilk_m min = 1 }
oe_ilk_ch_w19 = { value = 100 divide = oe_ilk_left_w19 }
oe_ilk_left_w20 = { value = 271 subtract = var:oe_ilk_m min = 1 }
oe_ilk_ch_w20 = { value = 100 divide = oe_ilk_left_w20 }
oe_ilk_left_w21k = { value = 565 subtract = var:oe_ilk_m min = 1 }
oe_ilk_ch_w21k = { value = 100 divide = oe_ilk_left_w21k }
oe_ilk_left_w21s = { value = 565 subtract = var:oe_ilk_m min = 1 }
oe_ilk_ch_w21s = { value = 100 divide = oe_ilk_left_w21s }
# Any scope. Armies compared by w17 (the Muzaffarids at least as strong as Kerman), w19 (one and a half times the
# Injuids), w21 (Timur's state three times the Kartids, three times the Sarbadars).
oe_ilk_krm_army = { value = 0 if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KRM } value = c:KRM.army_size } }
oe_ilk_inj_army_x15 = { value = 0 if = { limit = { country_exists = c:INJ } value = c:INJ.army_size multiply = 1.5 } }
oe_ilk_krt_army_x3 = { value = 0 if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KRT } value = c:KRT.army_size multiply = 3 } }
oe_ilk_srb_army_x3 = { value = 0 if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRB } value = c:SRB.army_size multiply = 3 } }
# Any scope. The record of w21 as one number: ones the Kartids, tens the Sarbadars (1-4 each).
oe_ilk_w21_val = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k global_var:oe_ilk_w21k = 1 } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k global_var:oe_ilk_w21k = 2 } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k global_var:oe_ilk_w21k = 3 } add = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k global_var:oe_ilk_w21k = 4 } add = 4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s global_var:oe_ilk_w21s = 1 } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s global_var:oe_ilk_w21s = 2 } add = 20 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s global_var:oe_ilk_w21s = 3 } add = 30 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s global_var:oe_ilk_w21s = 4 } add = 40 }
}

# BYZ scope. Readouts of phase 3 (at most five digits each). The value 0 while unset.
# oe_ilk_world_c: ones w17 Kerman, tens w18 Togha Temur, hundreds w19 Shiraz, thousands w20 Shah Shoja, ten thousands
# w21 Herat and the Sarbadars (1 at least one part done, 4 the engine refused, 3 a player, 2 none) (0 not yet, 1 done,
# 2 window passed, 3 a player or the imperial bloc involved, 4 the engine did not do it).
oe_ilk_world_c = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w17 global_var:oe_ilk_w17 = 1 } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w17 global_var:oe_ilk_w17 = 2 } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w17 global_var:oe_ilk_w17 = 3 } add = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w17 global_var:oe_ilk_w17 = 4 } add = 4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18 global_var:oe_ilk_w18 = 1 } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18 global_var:oe_ilk_w18 = 2 } add = 20 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18 global_var:oe_ilk_w18 = 3 } add = 30 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18 global_var:oe_ilk_w18 = 4 } add = 40 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19 global_var:oe_ilk_w19 = 1 } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19 global_var:oe_ilk_w19 = 2 } add = 200 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19 global_var:oe_ilk_w19 = 3 } add = 300 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19 global_var:oe_ilk_w19 = 4 } add = 400 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w20 global_var:oe_ilk_w20 = 1 } add = 1000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w20 global_var:oe_ilk_w20 = 2 } add = 2000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w20 global_var:oe_ilk_w20 = 3 } add = 3000 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w20 global_var:oe_ilk_w20 = 4 } add = 4000 }
    if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k global_var:oe_ilk_w21k = 1 } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s global_var:oe_ilk_w21s = 1 } } } add = 10000 }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k global_var:oe_ilk_w21k = 4 } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s global_var:oe_ilk_w21s = 4 } } } add = 40000 }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k global_var:oe_ilk_w21k = 3 } AND = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s global_var:oe_ilk_w21s = 3 } } } add = 30000 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21 } add = 20000 }
}
# oe_ilk_rd_w21: the two parts of w21: ones the Kartids, tens the Sarbadars.
oe_ilk_rd_w21 = { value = oe_ilk_w21_val }
# oe_ilk_rd_how3: ones w18 (1 Gurgan's claim taken, 2 it had none, 3 kept by the switch, 4 the engine left it), tens w21 the Kartids (1 vassal,
# 2 only truce and opinion), hundreds the Sarbadars (the same).
oe_ilk_rd_how3 = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18_claim global_var:oe_ilk_w18_claim = 1 } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18_claim global_var:oe_ilk_w18_claim = 2 } add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18_claim global_var:oe_ilk_w18_claim = 3 } add = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w18_claim global_var:oe_ilk_w18_claim = 4 } add = 4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k_how global_var:oe_ilk_w21k_how = 1 } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21k_how global_var:oe_ilk_w21k_how = 2 } add = 20 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s_how global_var:oe_ilk_w21s_how = 1 } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w21s_how global_var:oe_ilk_w21s_how = 2 } add = 200 }
}
# oe_ilk_rd_w19: how many subjects the Injuids had when w19 annexed them.
oe_ilk_rd_w19 = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ilk_w19_subs } value = global_var:oe_ilk_w19_subs } }
# oe_ilk_rd_tim: ones 1 Timur's state exists, tens 1 Timur himself is alive, hundreds 1 Gurgan still claims the Ilkhanate.
oe_ilk_rd_tim = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TIM } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_historical_timur_alive = yes } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_grg_claims = yes } add = 100 }
}
# BYZ scope. Ready (the test preparations): the premise of the step holds now, the date and the record aside (1 each).
# oe_ilk_rd_ready2: ones w9, tens w10, hundreds w12, thousands w13. oe_ilk_rd_ready2b: ones w14 a, tens w14 b, hundreds
# w14 c, thousands w15, ten thousands w16. oe_ilk_rd_ready3: ones w17, tens w18, hundreds w19, thousands w20, ten
# thousands w21 (1 the Kartids, 2 the Sarbadars, 3 both).
oe_ilk_rd_ready2 = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w9_ok = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w10_ok = yes } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w12_ok = yes } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w13_ok = yes } add = 1000 }
}
oe_ilk_rd_ready2b = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w14a_ok = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w14b_ok = yes } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w14c_ok = yes } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w15_ok = yes } add = 1000 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w16_ok = yes } add = 10000 }
}
oe_ilk_rd_ready3 = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w17_ok = yes } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w18_ok = yes } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w19_ok = yes } add = 100 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ilk_w20_ok = yes } add = 1000 }
